notes.title: Bundle Release: Get All Our Studio's Roguelikes at Once!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that you can now purchase (or complete your collection of) all three of our roguelikes at a significant discount. This bundle might interest those who want to track the progress of our tiny studio over the years. If you particularly enjoy any of the games, please don't hesitate to leave a review on its page. This helps us tremendously and shows us that people want more games like it.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43539/Think_and_Watch/

Meanwhile, we are working on something very secret, so shhh... Stay tuned!

notes.title: The release of version 1.0 of our game is here!
notes.notes:
If you're still on the fence about whether our game is your cup of tea after watching the trailers and reading the description, we highly recommend giving the demo version a whirl. You can play it solo or invite up to three friends to join the fun. The demo is basically a clone of the full version, with just one catch - you can't switch characters, and human players can only play as the knight. 

As for the game's future, we're committed to keeping an eye on any bug reports and balance issues - but hey, if we see enough enthusiasm, we might just start thinking about some meatier updates. 

Happy gaming!

notes.title: New Hero Arrives! Plus Bug Fixes, Balance Tweaks, and a Happy New Year Greeting
notes.notes:
In today’s update, a fourth hero has appeared in the game - the dark mage. Study the detailed skills in the game, but here we will just say that he specializes in poisons and a bit on… Dragons. But, spectral ones.

Now that there are four heroes to choose from, no one can reproach the game that out of 4 players someone is necessarily repeated :) In the demo version, you will not be able to play as the new hero, but he will consistently be against you - along with the archer and the fire mage.

What else is in this update? Various bug fixes and balance adjustments. Let’s highlight the main ones:

[list]
[*] The warrior’s damage from the first attack has been reduced.
[*] The skill responsible for piercing armor now increases the chance of a critical hit (with double damage) on heroes with a basic attack.
[*] The skeletons raised by necromancy now have a little more life.
[*] The additional special skill “On their land” is now fixed and strengthened, but will only act on “good” allies, that is, on the paladin and guards.
[*] We will continue to monitor the balance. The difficulty is added by the fact that AI plays much weaker than a person can with almost any hero. With the new hero - the dark mage - this is no exception. But we are working on it. :)
[/list]
We would like to remind you that the best support, which determines your interest in the further development of the project, is a review of the game on the game page. The more positive reviews - the more we see that we are not doing this in vain.

In the meantime - Happy upcoming New Year to everyone!

notes.title: Today’s Update: Balance Adjustments and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Balance Adjustments:

[list]
[*] Vampire and Paladin attack power increased.
[*] Damage of summoned skeletons increased.
[*] Damage of Dark Knights decreased.
[*] Dragon damage increased.
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Sound and music settings should now persist between game sessions.
[*] Fixed a bug where the tooltip window remained on the screen during multiplayer game launch.
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]
A suggestion for players: If you have been playing the full version and over many consecutive games (to ensure it’s not a coincidence) you find that a certain skill is too useless or too powerful - please let us know on the game forum or in Discord - we are currently tracking balance issues. Reworking anything is much more difficult, but we will gladly consider your suggestions related to changing numbers while the game is in early access.

notes.title: Major Demo Update and Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce two pieces of news. First, the game already has a release date - December 15th. Second, a very large update of the demo version has taken place. The demo version includes a large part of the game, you can play it with friends, (of course, absolutely free). And importantly - you can play it right now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44011066/5ae43052bc7d5d574b56a703534d4933e70a46df.png[/img]

We’re eager for you to experience this game both solo and with friends. That’s why the demo version includes almost the entire game, with just a couple of related limitations - you can only play as a warrior and you can’t switch the type of enemy heroes.

You can also watch this video - the version shown there is much closer to the release version. 

[previewyoutube=MHvizxP0umM;full][/previewyoutube]
We look forward to seeing you on the release date, December 15th! 

...And don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist if you haven’t done so already ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: A Touch of Necromancy? (Or Another Major Demo Update)
notes.notes:
The game now features not only a variety of altars for different play styles but also two new schools of mastery, each with four skills that can be upgraded five times. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44011066/ac178de60c5fa33ce8c6e9317fb3fdc820210f9f.png[/img]

Let’s talk a bit about the new schools. 
The game offers you, first of all, to follow the path of Light: act ‘the good way’, restoring lives, persuading guards to fight for you (presumably for the future king!). 
But you can also choose ‘the bad way’ - choose Darkness and the guards in the form of skeleton warriors, archers, and mages will have to serve you after death. 
Add to this elite units - paladins and vampires for the good and bad guys respectively. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44011066/4774a743922211db799de8c48801f3a1a87cf2d0.png[/img]

Although the new skill branches are largely dedicated to summoning, they are not limited to it - they also have skills for life restoration (who doesn’t love vampirism?) and for dealing damage. We’ll let you in on a secret (as you can guess from the skill wheel) there will also be a skill for those who like to take light and darkness at the same time, but don’t tell anyone. 

And we just need to remind you that in the demo you can play not only alone, but also with friends - you can play against bots, adjusting the difficulty to suit you, or against them. If you have any extra friends, of course.

And join our Discord server to find someone to play with: https://discord.gg/j7d4pckNM4

notes.title: Demo Update - Play Solo or With Friends!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Since the release of the first demo, a lot has changed, so if you haven’t had the chance to check it out or if you last visited a few weeks ago - now is a great time. In addition to other improvements made over the past few weeks, all four magic altars are now available in the game. 

Do you love raining fire down upon your enemies? Summoning golems for assistance? Freezing foes so they can’t move? Or perhaps you’d like to continuously use special attacks? 

No matter your style, we’ve got you covered! Choose the altar that aligns with your preferred element - and into battle! 

Finally, experiment with the difficulty settings for your opponents and their teams, and don’t forget to invite your friends as multiplayer is also available in the demo. Enjoy the auto-battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44011066/1e276667b4ed7f1c69d211ac27960788042b03ac.png[/img]
